property.name: Misty Mountain Plantation Resort
property.tagline: An old story waiting for new eyes
property.summary: Misty Mountain Plantation Resort is set amidst a lush 600-acre estate in the idyllic village of Peermade on the Sahyadri Hills of the Western Ghats of Kerala. A peaceful escape nestled in the greenery of Kuttikkanam, offering estate life experiences from tea factory tours to guided crop walks with a resident naturalist.

awards.presented_by: Cochin Chamber of Commerce & Altacit Global
Manorama Online Golden Clove Food Awards
awards.note: The homepage shows both a 2024 and a 2026 badge; the dining page describes the 2026 award.

rooms_accommodations.overview: Seven rooms in total: three Wooden Chalets and four rooms at the Reverie Cottage. All rooms are designed so guests can take in the surrounding landscape, with sit-outs or balconies.

types.name: Wooden Chalet
types.description: Three wooden chalets that seamlessly blend into the surroundings of the plantation. The chalets have private sit-outs, where guests commonly read a book or enjoy a hot beverage while soaking in the surroundings.
in_room_amenities: UV-filtered drinking water in glass bottles

types.name: Reverie Cottages
types.description: Set on two floors with two rooms on each floor, constructed with stone architecture that exudes an old-world charm. Every room has a balcony so guests can enjoy the sounds of nature and the crisp, cool breeze.
features: Two floors, two rooms per floor
in_room_amenities: UV-filtered drinking water in glass bottles

rooms_accommodations.pricing_note: No room rates are published anywhere on mistymountainexperience.in. Rates are quoted only through the third-party booking engine at https://hotels.travelnet.in/booking/misty-mountain-plantation-resort, which requires specific check-in/check-out dates, or by contacting the resort directly.

food_and_dining.overview: Two restaurants on property. The kitchen spans local Kerala delicacies, North Indian classics, continental creations and Asian specialties.

restaurants.name: Teyla Plantation Restaurant
restaurants.description: A vibrant quick-service restaurant offering a diverse menu that brings together global flavours with a modern twist - Continental classics, Chinese favourites, burgers and handcrafted sandwiches, plus an in-house bakery.
restaurants.award: Best Cafe & Casual Dining - Manorama Online Golden Clove Food Awards 2026

restaurants.name: Elam Restaurant
restaurants.description: Nestled within sprawling tea plantations, an idyllic setting for a relaxed family meal. Serves authentic Indian cuisine where vibrant flavours and rich aromas come together in dishes reflecting tradition and heartfelt passion.
menu_highlights: Signature desserts crafted by the pastry chef

other_food_experiences.name: Bakery & Patisserie
other_food_experiences.description: In-house bakery producing freshly made cakes, pastries and desserts.

other_food_experiences.name: Barbecue Night
other_food_experiences.description: Chef-grilled specialties such as marinated chicken, fresh vegetables and estate-grown spices cooked over open flames, served under the stars with live music.

other_food_experiences.name: Tea tasting
other_food_experiences.description: Freshly brewed estate tea served as part of the Orthodox Tea Tour, followed by lunch at the lounge.

food_and_dining.dietary_note: The site lists 'Do you cater to special dietary requirements?' as an FAQ, but the answer text is not published on the page. One published guest review notes vegetarian choices were limited.

in_room: UV-filtered drinking water served in glass bottles
property_facilities: Golf Room with virtual golf simulator
notes: Certain activities or facilities may be subject to seasonal availability, weather conditions, or maintenance schedules.
Charges may apply for selected amenities, activities, or services.
resources_amenities.unconfirmed: The site lists 'Do you have facilities for differently-abled guests?' as an FAQ, but no answer text is published. No swimming pool or spa is mentioned anywhere on the site.

items.name: The Orthodox Tea Tour
items.description: A guided jeep tour of the estate covering every stage of the tea-making process, starting with the leaf itself, plus the estate's other crops and wildlife. Includes a factory tour, tea tasting, and lunch at the lounge; begins after breakfast in your cabin.

items.name: Jeep Safari
items.description: Explore the rugged terrain of the biodiverse Western Ghats, observing native flora and fauna and learning how the estate's crops are farmed. Includes a visit to the natural waterfall on the property, most spectacular after the monsoon.

items.name: Plantation Walks
items.description: A leisurely guided stroll through the plantations with crisp mountain air and birdsong, learning the nuances of farming from resident guides.

items.name: Cycling
items.description: Bicycles are available on the property for a relaxed ride along the estate trails.

items.name: Fishing
items.description: Spend time by the tranquil water reserve at Misty Mountain; guides help set guests up with fishing rods and bait.

items.name: Kayaking
items.description: Paddle across the calm waters of the nearby dam reservoir in stable kayaks suited to beginners and experts alike, spotting birds and fish along the way.

items.name: Barbecue Night
items.description: An evening barbecue under the stars with chef-grilled specialties, live music, laughter, stargazing and storytelling. Suited to couples, families or groups.

items.name: Campfire
items.description: A crackling campfire in a safe, scenic clearing with plush seating, blankets and acoustic performances - roasting marshmallows, sharing tales and hot beverages under Peermade's clear skies.

items.name: Golf Room
items.description: A Golf Room featuring a custom virtual golf simulator - a relaxing indoor alternative to the outdoor adventures, suitable for all ages.

activities.booking_note: Activities are subject to weather conditions. Prebooking activities carries a 10% discount.
activities.pricing_note: No activity prices are published on the website.

policies.early_late_note: Early check-ins or late check-outs may incur additional charges.
policies.payment: A 30% advance or full payment is required at the time of booking, depending on the rate plan chosen.
policies.identification: Valid government-issued photo ID required for all guests at check-in. Foreign nationals must produce a passport and a copy of their visa.
policies.occupancy: Maximum occupancy of 3 people per room.
policies.children: Children under 5 may stay free with accompanying adults.
policies.activities: Activities are subject to weather conditions.

cancellation.flexible_rate: Cancellations at least 30 days before check-in are eligible for a full refund. Within 30 days, only a partial refund is issued. Guests may reschedule without forfeiting the booking amount, but must pay the difference if the new dates fall in a higher-rate period.
cancellation.close_cancellation: Cancellations 1 or 2 days prior to check-in are subject to full retention - no refund.
cancellation.no_show: Failure to check in without prior intimation results in full retention of the booking amount.

liability: The resort is not responsible for loss, theft, or damage to personal belongings.
Guests are liable for any damage to resort property caused during their stay.
